name: Venomancer: Rot Lich's free Serpent's Fang reaches the client as a cost modifier (#11214)
contract: #11214: after a Rot Lich proc the Serpent's Fang button stayed grey at low mana. 706032 'Your next Serpent's Fang
within $d is free of cost' was made free only inside the server's CalcPowerCost, so no cost spell modifier was
sent and the client kept checking Serpent's Fang's own 20% base mana cost before submitting the cast.
706032 now carries a -100% SPELLMOD_COST (14) aura effect on its own Serpent's Fang mask, the same modifier the
authored Rot Lich record 707321 holds (BasePoints -101 + 1); in family 35 that mask matches only the 16 Serpent's
Fang ranks. A native spell modifier is what the client receives (SMSG_SET_PCT_SPELL_MODIFIER), so spell_modifier
op 14 on base 1000 must read 0 with the buff and 1000 without it.

steps.label: CONTROL: no cost modifier on Serpent's Fang without the buff
SETUP: the free Serpent's Fang buff is active
DISCRIMINATING: the buff sends a -100% cost modifier for Serpent's Fang
Serpent's Fang costs no mana with the buff
